title: FTSE Russell Q1 2027 quarterly review takes effect at the open — recent IPOs enter the Russell US indexes and the Russell US Style capping recap implements, priced from the 2027-03-10 cut-off
source: EST: owner-published convention, re-derived first-hand this session. FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions — Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09): its schedule table publishes "Russell US Style Capping Cut-Off Date — 11 March 2026 / 17 June 2026 / 9 September 2026 / 2 December 2026" against "Review Effective Date (open of) — 23 March 2026 / 29 June 2026 / 21 September 2026 / 14 December 2026". The convention that reproduces all four published 2026 columns to the day is: review effective at the open of the Monday after the quarter's implementation Friday, and the style capping cut-off twelve calendar days before that Monday. March 2027's implementation Friday is the third Friday, 2027-03-19, so the review is effective at the open of Monday 2027-03-22 and the cut-off is Wednesday 2027-03-10. The already-tracked russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2026-09-21 is the same event one quarter class earlier and its date is the owner's own published 21 September 2026, so this is the missing 2027 member of a series this calendar already carries rather than a new class. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner. Proposed by russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-03-31 initial research, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BECAUSE IT IS LOAD-BEARING ON THE PROPOSER'S OWN NUMBER, not swept up by habit — the same standard the proposal that created this event applied. Guide v5.4 §4.8.3, read verbatim this session: "The index weights used in the test are calculated using closing constituent prices on the price date and incorporate forward-looking constituents, shares in issue, and investability weights, including any current capping adjustments, designated to take effect on or before the effective date specified in Section 4.8.6." The capping adjustments effective at THIS open, priced from the 2027-03-10 cut-off, are therefore exactly the adjustments the 2027-03-25 quarter-end test reads. That makes 2027-03-10 the anchor of the proposer's entire base rate — the 11-session drift window 2027-03-10 → 2027-03-25 that prices at 40/1,243 = 3.22% — and this file is where that anchor's date lives. A calendar that carries the quarter-end check without carrying the review that resets it has no way to date its own drift window. Note also that 2027-03-22 is a double index-flow session: sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22 is proposed in the same PR and shares the date. Impact low and symbols empty for the family's measured reasons: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-09), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta.
